name: Taiho Shichau zo
summary:
Arriving late for her first day working at the Bokuto Police Department, the hotheaded Natsumi Tsujimoto feels uneasy about working with her new partner, the comparatively stiff Miyuki Kobayakawa. However, after learning that underneath Miyuki's rule-following exterior is a savvy mechanic who is extremely skilled behind the wheel of her heavily modified patrol car, Natsumi finds that her partner may be exactly what she needs.

From apprehending reckless street racers to protecting their community, the two young women serve their city with tremendous energy and form a bond that extends far beyond their workplace.

This is original OVA series and not time-constrained. TV series later are continuation of this story, though first four episodes are edited versions of these OVA episodes.

name: Is It Cake? Halloween
summary: Cake or fake? Trick or treat? Skilled bakers whip up hyperrealistic Halloween cakes in this seasonal special edition of the hit competition series.

name: Taiho Shichau zo Special
summary: Best friends and partners Miyuki Kobayakawa and Natsumi Sujimoto, along with the rest of the gang at Bokuto station, confront a motley group of offenders ranging from hi-tech panty thieves, purse-snatchers, and traffic violators. Using Miyuki's driving prowess and tech knowledge, as well as Natsumi's spunk and strength, the duo at times must resort to unconventional methods to see that justice is served.

name: Japan, the Land of Cats in the Year 2200
summary: Takes place in the year 2200, where Japan has become a land of cats as the human population's birth rate has declined. In this future world, cats can talk, learn, and work. The story follows a high school girl and her argumentative cat.

name: Санкционер
summary: Vasily Baranov, who built a business abroad, falls under foreign sanctions and is suddenly deprived of everything. The news finds him in his native Semibolotsk, where he has not been for almost thirty years. Vasily turns to his family for support, but no one talks to him. Thinking that the reason lies in his sudden poverty, the former oligarch decides to get rich again in order to regain the respect of his father and ex-fiancee, and now the mayor's wife. Baranov's only ally — is a local taxi driver, whose wife, for some reason, is sharply against her husband's communication with the ex-billionaire.

name: Hvor er Odin?
summary: 18-year-old Odin disappears after a night out in Trondheim. A desperate search for answers begins when his belongings mysteriously turn up.

name: Soundtrack #2
summary: Suho and Hyunseo, who once dated for six years, meet again as a youthful rich CEO and a piano instructor. K works with Suho on a collaborative project and invites Hyeonseo to join them. Suho and Hyunseo embark on a bumpy romantic journey full of twists and turns. Will history repeat itself?

name: Annabel Crabb's Civic Duty
summary:
Australians rarely pause to appreciate the miracle behind the ballot box. How often do we stop and marvel at what we've built? How many of us know that the familiar, uncontroversial features of our electoral system are – in global terms – highly unusual? And how many of us have heard the rollicking backstories of the democratic dreamers and reformed felons behind it?

Across three episodes Annabel Crabb's Civic Duty unearths the individuals and stories that combine to make Australian democracy globally unique, like our invention of the secret ballot, our adoption of preferential and compulsory voting, and our peculiar attachment to sausages.

Annabel travels both here and abroad to investigate how the politics of our parliament have changed thanks to political leaders, the media landscape – but most of all - the power of the Australian people.

name: Gintama: Mr. Ginpachi's Zany Class
summary: Class is in session—and it's out of control! Sakata Ginpachi teaches Gintama High School's Class 3-Z, a ragtag bunch of idol otaku, stalkers, mayo guzzlers, sadists, and more. Fights break out, rules are ignored, and sanity is optional. Every day spirals into chaos, but Ginpachi somehow survives it all with nonchalance and almost zero effort. When the bell rings, chaos begins!

previousepisode.name: Old Times Talk in Reunions and Last Episode Recaps in Anime Are Just Fillers for When You Have Nothing to Show or Talk About

name: Strange Chronicles of Tang: The Nine-Tiered Labyrinth
Great Estates from Above
summary:
Great Estates from Above is a series that uses cutting-edge drone and aerial photography to reveal Britain's most magnificent country houses and palaces from an entirely new perspective.

Soaring over grand estates, the series captures their breathtaking architecture, formal gardens, and sweeping parklands in extraordinary detail, while uncovering rich histories and personal stories from the families and staff who care for them.

With intimate interviews and mesmerizing visuals, this narrator-led journey offers a unique glimpse into these iconic landmarks, many made famous by series like Downton Abbey and Bridgerton, showcasing their timeless beauty and ongoing preservation efforts from a vantage point few have ever seen.

name: End Game with Tony Armstrong
summary:
Fed up with excuses and failed campaigns, Tony Armstrong is on a mission to tackle racism in Australian sport. The former AFL player turned award-winning broadcaster embarks on a global search for solutions he hopes can drive systemic change to Australia's own major sporting codes.

Through conversations with former athletes and sporting legends such as Sydney Swans' Adam Goodes and Manchester United and England captain Rio Ferdinand, by exploring the role of athlete activism, uncovering breakthrough AI technology that tracks online hate and challenging our major codes to take stronger action, Tony seeks to inspire meaningful change in tackling racism in sport.

Tony's mission to create a better future for athletes at all levels won't happen overnight, but through athletes, institutions, and leadership, sport has the power to reshape Australia.

name: Killing Hitler
summary: A limited series revealing how ordinary Germans planned to become Hitler's assassin and change history.

name: Gingerbread Land: The Biggest Little Holiday Competition
summary: Gingerbread Land: The Biggest Little Holiday Competition contestants transform flour, sugar, and candy into intricate works of art, competing in playful rounds that test design, structure, and creativity. Each week, new challenges bring twists and surprises, while Oliver Hudson guides the fun with warmth and humor, inviting viewers into a magical holiday world, where imagination has no limits.

name: The Last Frontier
summary: A wealthy, spoiled young woman moves from Los Angeles to Alaska, where she is forced to rent a cottage from three local men she considers below her social status.

name: Discretion
summary: Discretion is a legal thriller about a summer associate Lenny at a prestigious Dallas law firm who uncovers a web of NDAs masking a dark truth. When she realizes she signed the same agreement, her discoveries put her in the crosshairs of the firm's most powerful female partner Sharon —upending their mentor-protégé dynamic and raising the question: who gets to keep secrets, and at what cost?

name: Ravneet Gill's Chop House
summary: Ravneet Gill's Chop House follows the culinary and entrepreneurial journey of Ravneet Gill and her husband Mattie, as they set out to open their own restaurant.

name: Boku no Satsui ga Koisuru Mae
summary: Spinoff to Boku no Satsui ga Koi wo Shita.

name: El Centro
summary: Set in the present day, but with echoes of the Cold War, this spy thriller delves into the unknown world of "El Centro" - National Intelligence Center of the Spain (CNI). The plot begins with a murder that uncovers an international operation by the Russian intelligence services and leads the CNI members into a race against time to dismantle it, while also trying to uncover a traitor within their ranks.

name: Unicornland
summary: Unicornland is an 8-episode webseries about Annie, who explores her sexuality post-divorce by dating couples. ...Over drinks, at dinner, and in bed. Each episode features a date with a new couple, from Williamsburg hipsters, to Wall Street power duos, to Bushwick burners, as Annie becomes not just sexually active, but activated. Unicornland was created/produced by Lucy Gillespie, directed by Nick Leavens, and shot by a 70% female cast and crew. Unicornland celebrates the ethnic and social diversity of New York City, with a cast that's 60% non-white, including trans, genderqueer and disabled actors. Unicornland contains themes of polyamory and open relationships, and was made with the full support of the New York sex positive community. In the final episode, Annie attends her first inclusive sex party at the Hacienda Villa, a renowned epicenter of the New York scene.

previousepisode.name: The Sex Party - Katherine and Joshua

name: 195 Lewis
summary: It is a dramatic comedy series about a group of friends navigating the realities of being Black, queer, and polyamorous in New York City.

name: Die Alpen
summary:
The Alps – wild mountains, extreme lives, but also a magical world.

This majestic mountain range connects eight countries and reaches heights of up to 4 000 metres above sea level. The so-called "Roof of Europe" continues to fascinate – across the continent and around the world. The incredible diversity of landscapes, flora and fauna makes the Alps a unique natural treasure at the heart of Europe.

Enjoy the Alps in spring and summertime as newborn animals grow up to face the coming brutal winter. Experience the hostile and bitter cold ecosystems of the Alps, shaped by snow blizzards and avalanches.

name: Lars og Lars
summary: "Lars and Lars" is a program series that follows the two fishing enthusiasts Lars Nilssen and Lars Lenth on their fishing trips, often in search of large trout and inspired by historical fishing descriptions, such as the book "Tre i Norge ved to av dem" from 1882. They travel to various places in Norway to experience fishing happiness and challenges related to fishing, as shown in the VGTV series, among others.

name: Groapa
summary: Groapa presents a realistic and harsh picture of mafia life, family relationships, problems and love stories in a way that will make the people at home enjoy every second and understand that family is everything .

name: Iconic Combat Machines
summary: Impressive war machines from the Second World War to the current day, combining expert analysis and modern combat simulators to reveal their enduring legacy.

name: Great British Train Journeys from Above
summary:
All aboard, this is your ticket to ride the most spectacular train journeys in Britain. To mark 200 years of British train travel in 2025, this series uses cutting-edge drones to showcase the most iconic steam train journeys in Britain, from above.

In Scotland, the Jacobite Steam Train, better known as the Hogwarts Express, travels across the Scottish Highlands, unlocking the fascinating history of the Jacobite Rebellion. In Wales, the Mountain Spirit traverses glorious coastlines and ancient oak woodlands on the Ffestiniog Railway, through the mountainous Snowdonia National Park. And in England, the North Yorkshire Moors Railway travels from Whitby to Pickering, transporting us back in time to the golden age of steam train travel, and the West Somerset Railway scales rolling hills, to tell the story if its great engineer, Isambard Kingdom Brunel.

In this spectacular series, immerse yourself in the romance, history and thrill of train travel.

name: Dai Byouin Senkyo Mae: The Night Before
summary: Half a year before the occupation incident. Koichi struggles to discover the truth Kaiseido Hospital hides. Meanwhile, Koichi and Sagami infiltrate Tajima Design Office, which designed Kaiseido Hospital. They're looking for blueprint data, but suddenly three employees and a security guard show up. It seems that they were contacted by the police asking them to come because they wanted to hear about the theft. However, the elevator that everyone got on stops on the way. Furthermore, a mysterious gas blows out and consciousness is cut off. When they woke up, they heard a mysterious voice telling them that a black object had been wrapped around the necks of the employees, and that a poisonous injection had been placed in their collars. Amidst a sudden sense of urgency, the voice added: "If you want to get out of the elevator alive, find the killer inside."

name: Tokyo Tower: Another Story
summary: The story follows Koji, who is curious about Shishi, who has made Toru, who had never had any interest in romance, fall in love with him so much. One day, while working a part-time job, he bumps into Shishi, and although he says it's for his best friend Toru, he calls out to Shishi out of curiosity, and the two end up spending time together.

name: Kitchen Curious
summary: Vivian Howard unpacks the secrets, shortcuts, and science behind everyday cooking.

name: La encrucijada
summary: César Bravo returns from Mexico, almost thirty years later, to the land of his birth, when no one remembers his father's last name or the tragic circumstances surrounding his death and that of his grandparents. Although his appearance as an adventurous tourist doesn't betray it, he is very clear about what he's coming for. He won't find peace until he achieves justice and puts Octavio Oramas in prison, the man who appropriated his father's family history and everything that belonged to him to create his own empire. What César doesn't count on is that on his path he will cross Amanda Oramas, the apple of his enemy's eye, with whom he will fall madly in love. A fortuitous crossroads that marks a before and after in the lives of two rival families. What will win: love or revenge?

name: Pílula de Farinha: O Escândalo que Gerou Vidas
summary: In 1998, placebos of the best-selling contraceptive reached pharmacies, causing pregnancies and a scandal that affected many Brazilian women.

name: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
summary: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas. And because the holidays are a time for cooking with the ones you love, chefs will be invited to pair up in teams of two to compete for glory and goodwill. In every battle, teams will serve up a savory and a sweet dish based on the spin of the Randomizer. The chef teams will need to be in sync and on their game to earn the title, the belt, a $100,000 cash prize furnished by Carnival Cruise Lines and their split of an additional $50,000 prize to give to a cause close to their hearts.

name: Sweet Empire: Winter Wars
summary: Sweet Empire: Winter Wars where fourteen of the most competitive and talented sweets makers are invited to the Yuletide Lodge for a competition unlike any other. While the competitors enter as individuals, their goal will be to get on-- and stay on-- the strongest team by any means necessary, because in this game the bakers must create incredible edible works of art to grow their teams and avoid elimination. In the end, teams will crumble until only the strongest will be left standing to become the Sweet Empire.

name: The Antiques Riviera
summary:
The Antiques Riviera is a new six-part series for Channel 4's More4 that escapes to the beautiful south coast to discover what fortunes can be made for Brits with treasure to cash in.

A honeypot for antique traders, this corner of Britain is a destination for buyers and sellers alike. This new series, produced in Glasgow by STV Studios Factual (Antiques Road Trip, The Yorkshire Auction House), brings this wonderful world to screen with a new format that follows a colourful cast of expert traders and local dealers. 

Each hour-long episode will welcome a new seller who is looking to turn their items into cash. By offering their heirlooms and antiques to dealers up and down the Devon coastline, the sellers hope they'll leave with as much money as possible to fund their dreams – whether that's a once-in-a-lifetime holiday, deposit for their first home, or even their wedding.

Viewers will be treated to an escapist journey through the villages and towns of The Antiques Riviera, as our dealers reveal their tips and tricks to finding hidden valuables that could end up making a life-changing profit.

name: Hamza's Hidden Wild Isles
summary: Wonder is everywhere – if you know where to look. From sunny beaches to rugged moors, craggy munros to city streets, Hamza Yassin reveals amazing wildlife hidden around the UK.

name: Britain's Most Scenic Counties: Cheshire
summary:
From the amazing views towards the Welsh mountains to the bucolic village byroads around Tarporley; Cheshire is like a picture- postcard.
This four -part series showcases the charms of Cheshire through some of the county's proud residents as they live, work and play in the beautiful county they call home. From traditional cheese makers to the famous zoo we follow the locals as the county pops with wonderful Autumn colour. Exploring the county's industrial and artisanal past, this series reveals a deep history that the residents of Cheshire are proud to be a part of.

name: Подкаст «Опасные связи»
summary: The podcast "Dangerous Liaisons" is a new, candid project on the CHE! TV channel, where host Dmitry Rybin and psychologist Dmitry Gukhman talk to people tired of their own infidelity. Their faces are hidden, and their voices are disguised. However, the characters share a goal: to stop. Will the participants be able to uncover the true reasons for their unacceptable behavior and reveal their true colors?

name: Wild About Animals
summary: Wild About Animals is a documentary television series about a guide to the world of animals. The series is hosted by Mariette Hartley.

name: The Age of Passion
summary: For the sake of his first love, Zhou Mingrui makes the drastic decision to drop out. Together with his buddies Xu Jiaming and Pan Bowen, he chases their shared dream of creating a game. Starting from scratch, the trio battles a lack of funds, technical hurdles, and market skepticism, working tirelessly to perfect their creation. These three ordinary dreamers, supporting each other against all odds, ultimately find their path to success.

name: ESCAPE
summary: A bizarre escape begins with two people—a hostage and a kidnapper. The only daughter of a major corporation is kidnapped, but the plan fails. As the young kidnapper stands still, stunned, the hostage begs him, "Please, run away with me!" As the chasers close in, they become increasingly encircled. Friends and enemies switch sides. What is she running from? What is the hidden secret? With the kidnapping as the catalyst, the gears of destiny start to turn. Where will the two of them end up? This thrilling, nonstop human suspense story is sure to shake your soul.

name: Afterlife with Archie
summary: When Jughead's beloved pet Hot Dog is killed, he turns to Sabrina the Teenage Witch to bring him back with dark magic. While she succeeds, Hot Dog comes back changed and spreads a zombie plague that forces Archie and his friends to fight for survival and escape the now-infected Riverdale.

name: The Bad Guys: The Series
summary: How did the Bad Guys break into the bad guy business in the first place? Find out in this hilarious prequel series set before the hit films.

name: Kuruluş: Orhan
summary: This epic historical series, set at the beginning of the 14th century, focuses on the life of Orhan, son of Osman I and the second ruler of the Ottoman Empire—the man who transformed a small frontier Turkmen principality into a great empire that expanded into Europe and dominated much of the world for centuries.

name: День семьи
summary: Representatives of the older generation of the family, Vladimir and Marina, have already fulfilled their parental duty and sent daughter Ira and son Kolya into adulthood. The couple hopes to finally live for themselves, but Marina finds out about her pregnancy. And that's at 55! In turn, Ira is already raising two children from her first marriage with her new husband, Semyon. The couple decide to go into business and open their own cheese shop, but it turns out that being sole proprietors is not so easy. As for Kolya, he's just getting married. However, the choice of the bride surprises everyone — the guy makes an offer to a housekeeper from Central Asia, Aida.

name: The Gnomes of Dulwich
summary: Big, Small, and Old are three stone gnomes who live in the front garden of No. 25 Telegraph Road. All three appear to lead such serene lives, Big fishing with his rod, Old fast asleep holding his spade, and Small feeding his frog all day. But their serenity is not all it might seem at first glance. Even stone gnomes can have trouble, trouble with the neighbours - especially when they are different.

name: Witches of Essex
summary:
Rylan Clark teams up with anthropologist Professor Alice Roberts to investigate one of the darkest and most harrowing chapters in British history - the murder of hundreds of women accused of witchcraft.

Each episode centres on a specific witch trial, with Rylan and Alice opening a cold case into the stories behind some of the women accused of witchcraft during the 16th and 17th centuries, many of whom were found guilty and sentenced to death by hanging.

They visit the towns and villages in Essex where the women lived and died. Guided by original court documents and a team of historians, psychologists and medical experts, they explore these women's lives, alleged crimes and trials.

name: The Promised Land
summary: On their way from Egypt to the promised land, Moses and his family struggle to manage the hardest part of their nation's journey: the people.

name: Harlan Coben's Final Twist
summary: Harlan Coben's Final Twist brings the top selling mystery author to true crime as he unravels murder cases to expose hidden truths.

name: Bateau Mouche: O Naufrágio da Justiça
summary: Docuseries about the shipwreck that shocked Brazil in 1988, a disaster marked by greed, negligence and impunity.

name: Olivia and Alex: Parenthood
summary: Series following Love Island stars Olivia and Alex Bowen as they prepare for and welcome their second child into their family, navigating this new chapter while dealing with the emotional experience of losing one of their twins during a previous pregnancy.

name: Ed Gein: Original Psycho
summary:
Inspired by the chilling rediscovery of Ed Gein's original three-day police interrogation transcripts, this extraordinary two-part series brings to life one of America's most infamous true crime stories in a way never seen before.

Ed Gein: Original Psycho is a chilling documentary that places viewers face-to-face with one of history's most disturbing killers, the man whose crimes inspired Psycho, The Texas Chainsaw Massacre, and The Silence of the Lambs.

name: The Cheetah
summary: The story follows Chen Hansheng, a military academy graduate who dreams of joining the special forces. Through unrelenting effort, he wins the recognition of Ling Zhengrong, acting commander of the Leopard unit, instructor Qiu Tian, and Zhang Lan, head of the repair squad. Finally admitted into the elite Leopard Assault Team, Chen Hansheng faces life-and-death trials alongside his teammates. Tempered by countless arduous missions, he evolves into a seasoned soldier, showcasing the passion and responsibility of a new-generation warrior forged through growth and sacrifice.

name: To Bend the Waist
summary: Adapted from Peng Laike's novel of the same name, set in a fictional chaotic world during the late Eastern Han Dynasty. The Wei and Qiao families are enemies due to past grievances. After the Qiao family's decline, they betray their eldest daughter and marry Xiao Qiao to Wei Shao. Wei Shao, harboring hatred for his father and brother's tragic deaths, coldly sends Xiao Qiao back to her hometown in Youzhou the day after their wedding. However, using memories from her past life and her own wisdom, Xiao Qiao overcomes the Wei family's difficulties and Empress Su E's repeated schemes. During times of crisis, she and Wei Shao support each other. Wei Shao is gradually moved by her gentleness and courage, lets go of his hatred, and begins pursuing his wife. Eventually, they work together to resolve their family conflicts. Wei Shao becomes emperor, Xiao Qiao becomes empress, and together they protect the peace of the realm.

name: Marie and Her Three Daddies
summary: A drama depicting the birth of an unusual family, thicker than blood and more tenacious than sperm.

name: Reloved
summary: Than, a single man who owns a fitness gym, suddenly has to take care of his niece, Nene, after his brother passes away unexpectedly. His life changes when he unexpectedly reunites with Akin, his former lover who disappeared years ago. They meet again when they bring their kids to the same school. Old memories resurface, and Than begins to search for the truth about why Akin vanished from his life.

name: A(ir) Moment
summary:
In the post-Cold War world, particularly since 1953, the study of the human mind has been widely conducted to manage human resources. This includes the secret MK-Ultra project, as well as the ethical and freedom-of-thought issues of AI. It's undeniable that many organizations around the world are using it to exert power over humanitarian gains, choosing it as a "tool" to control reality, ultimately transforming humans into weapons more terrifying than any bomb.
This prelude, in the form of interviews, will introduce you to the creators and actors involved in this sci-fi series, the inspiration behind the characters, and the experiences the actors have encountered along the way. It will make you question humanity, right and wrong, love, and hope. Perhaps we are being swayed by the mind control that permeates every part of our lives, leading us to re-examine whether we still own our own thoughts.

name: Bigfoot Took Her
summary:
When teenager Theresa Bier mysteriously vanished in California's Sierra National Forest in 1987, a surprising suspect emerged: Bigfoot. Now, investigator Jessica Chobot and 29-year LAPD veteran Robert Collier reopen one of the most bizarre missing persons cases in modern history in hopes of bringing closure to Theresa's unsolved disappearance.

Stranger than the lore that surrounds it, this mind-bending mystery compels the pair to reinvestigate the decades-old disappearance in search of new clues and evidence that may finally solve this unusual cold case once and for all. Interviewing witnesses who have never spoken publicly, exploring new photos, retracing Theresa's final moments, and digging into recently uncovered police reports about possible drug trafficking, serial killers and unspoken family drama, the duo unravels new theories about what may have happened on that fateful day. And why, amid all the evidence, people in her hometown accepted that Bigfoot was not just lore…but her murderer.

name: The Bad Guys Holiday Specials
summary: A series of holiday specials featuring characters from the successful children's film.

name: Stunner
summary: Song Zhi Wei's father had an affair when she was young. Her mother's health deteriorated day by day and she suffered from depression. She eventually committed suicide. Later on her father's mistress, Zhong Nian, became pregnant. She took advantage of the child to get ahead and excluded Song Zhi Wei. She used some of Song Zhi Wei's mother's things to stimulate her and started a dispute. During which, Zhong Nian deliberately fell down the stairs and falsely accused Song Zhi Wei of pushing her. This incident angered her father, who sent her abroad to study. Eight years later, Song Zhi Wei came back and deliberately approached her uncle-in-law for revenge. They already had an intersection five years earlier. Chu Han Ting knew that she was using him, but he was willing to be her pawn.

name: Ye Se Wen Rou
summary: Wen Yan was a servant of the Chu family and Chu Shi Yu's nanny. She has been silently giving and handling everything for him. However, when Chu Shi Yu hurt her family, she decided to leave. When they met again, Wen Yan had become Fu Han Si's secretary. On a rainy night, Chu Shi Yu knelt down and begged Wen Yan to return, but Fu Han Si domineeringly declared his ownership of Wen Yan. The love between the two became more and more firm in the interweaving of power and emotion.

name: Long Coveted
summary: Lin Wu tried her best to sleep with her future brother-in-law Xie Yan Shen. She was very ambitious and wanted him to submit to her, to avenge her stepmother and half sister, and to take back her mother's relics.

name: Spring Scenery Cannot Be Deceived
summary: While studying abroad, Shu Yang met Qi Yan, an elite translator. Shu's father, intent on bringing them together, arranged for her to stay at Qi Yan's home. Over the course of four years, their relationship blossomed, but Qi Yan's half-brother threatened Shu Yang, leaving her emotionally wounded and kidnapped. She lost her memories. Qi Yan thought, "Let's wait, wait a little longer. Once he's dealt with all the unforeseen circumstances, he'll give Shu Yang the promise she desires." Four years later, Shu Yang and a friend opened a bar together. With cash running low, she received a marriage proposal from Qi Yan...

name: The Fiery Young Marshal
summary: Song Shuang Xu was abandoned by her parents at a young age. Shen Yu brought her home and raised her as a princess. She mistook dependence for love and was "exiled" abroad by the Shen family for many years. After returning to China, the Shen family was framed. She became He Ting Zhou's secret lover to repay the favor, but she didn't know that he had been secretly in love with her for many years. His meticulous care made her understand what true love is.

name: East of Eden
summary: Qiao Xin Ran lives a very difficult life, even working as a food delivery person, to pay for her mother-in-law's medical treatment. One day, while on a delivery, she makes a shocking discovery: her husband, Liang Yu Xuan, is actually the wealthy heir to the Liang family. At the same time, she sees him proposing to his first love. Devastated, she decides to get a divorce. The president of the Chu Corporation, Chu Ming Yi, offers help and invites her to join his company. Meanwhile, Liang Yu Xuan continues to harass and bother her. During a company celebration, Qiao Xinran tries to prove her worth and establish herself, but she is obstructed and sabotaged by Liang Yu Xuan and his new partner, Anna.

name: Sin frenos
summary: A delivery man and a high society widow open a hostel for immigrants-forgetting to hang the sign that says 'No Drama Allowed.' They face more secrets than beds, a romance hotter than their free Wi-Fi, and a neighborhood determined to shut them down.

name: Paranormaal Vlaanderen
summary: A docuseries that follows five extraordinary Flemish people in miraculous situations and encounters, where they discover a mysterious world of extrasensory phenomena that current science deems impossible.

name: SpongeBob SquarePants Netflix Movies
summary: A series of character based movies that features characters from the show SpongeBob SquarePants.

name: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story
summary:
Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story tells the story of how one young woman changed what the world believed a killer could be... all it took was an axe.

When the repressed daughter of a wealthy New England family and her rebellious maid find themselves trapped in a house built on humiliation and cruelty, they escape into a fantasy of sex, power, and revenge. The gruesome unsolved murders that follow don't just shock the world—they give birth to an icon who refuses to live imprisoned in a cage, choosing instead to forge her own legend: shocking, monstrous, and gloriously free.

name: Affair ender REI
summary: Working for a company specializing in breaking up in-office romances, Rei Saegusa infiltrates an event-planning firm to target a toxic workplace affair.

name: Sigmar's Toll
summary: The show is focusing on the Hallowed Knights defending the city of Embergard against a massive Skaven Vermindoom invasion.

name: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - BNW no Chikai
summary:
Biwa Hayahide, Narita Taishin, and Winning Ticket (commonly called BNW) were scheduled to run in the "G1 Osaka Hai," but had lost their motivation to race. Concerned, the student council organized the "BNW Ekiden" at the Fan Appreciation Festival — a relay where 7 runners per team pass a sash — hoping to inspire the three to rally. The <Spica> members, including Special Week, are tasked with persuading them, but struggle to get through. They wish for the trio to rekindle the passionate friendship they had around the Derby… Meanwhile, at the festival, the "Can Oguri Cap eat 1,000 bowls of wanko soba?" show is held at the same time!

This 3-part OVA continues right after season 1 of <b>Uma Musume: Pretty Derby</b> and was included with the fourth volume of Uma Musume: Pretty Derby blu-ray release.

name: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - Road to the Top
summary: Road to the Top delves into the lives of newer-generation Uma Musume, focusing on their challenges, growth, and aspirations in the competitive world of racing. The series highlights the journey of these characters as they strive to make a name for themselves, facing both internal and external obstacles. Through their stories, the anime explores themes of perseverance, teamwork, and the pursuit of dreams.

name: Nodame Cantabile in Europe
summary: This 2 night special takes off during their graduation, where Chiaki-senpai & Nodame left for Europe. The first special centered on Chiaki's story, the story tells about Chiaki's dream to be a conductor. Nodame on the other hand attended the conservatory to attain her dream to one-day play the piano for Chiaki. After her hard work, Nodame was given a chance to have a mini recital. During the recital, Chiaki saw her worth and realized that he cannot go on with out her.

name: Verstappen Lion Unleashed
summary: In the Lion Unleashed series, we look back at the Dutch driver's World Championship successes which has kept him at the very top four years in a row.

name: Miss King
summary: The daughter of a genius shogi player channels the pain of her father's abandonment and her mother's death to become an elite competitor.

name: The End of an Era
summary: An unprecedented backstage pass alongside Taylor Swift as her record-breaking tour comes to an end.

name: Raske jenter
summary: Four uncompromising girls take on the male-dominated sports of motorsports, where one mistake can ruin a career, battling the clock, their competitors and themselves.

name: Charterfeber Sverige
summary: What happens when Swedes leave their everyday routines behind to embrace the charter life of sunbathing, humid evenings out and fast-paced adventures? We find the answers in söta bror's edition of Charterfeber.

name: Jan Åges Unplugged
summary: Jan Åge Fjørtoft meets famous personalities who are in one way or another connected to international football. There will be anecdotes, reminiscences and a wealth of unknown stories.

name: Spirituelle Stjerner
summary: Get a rare and completely unique insight into a world full of magic and spirituality, when eight spiritual guides open the door to their work with everything from palm reading and crystals to soul journeys and contact with the deceased.

name: Fighting Nicolas Dalby
summary:
This is an honest story about MMA fighter Nicolas Dalby's violent decline, from successful UFC fighter to depressed and unemployed, as well as his struggle to get back on track both personally and professionally.

Premiered in 2019.

name: Juan Gabriel: Debo, puedo y quiero
summary: Rare videos and exclusive interviews reveal the genius, sacrifices and duality between the public and private lives of iconic singer-songwriter Juan Gabriel.

name: Мастерская
summary: The workshop is a place where cool toys and funny inventions are created from the most ordinary things that everyone has at home!

name: Nadie nos vio partir
summary: A mother faces stigma and a painful separation when her husband takes their children abroad, forever changing her life. Based on a true story.

name: Etterforsket
summary: Join TV 2's crime reporters behind the scenes in their coverage of the biggest crime cases.

name: La famille Rose
summary: As a family get stuck in a charming village of the French coutryside, a string of unexpected events triggers an investigation that tears them appart and threatens to expose their terrible secret: they can only feed on human flesh.

name: So, You Make It
summary: A woman loses herself by playing the "perfect girlfriend," cooking elaborate meals for her partner, while her old-fashioned boyfriend assumes women should cook. After a smooth college romance and cohabitation, they break up right after his proposal. Through cooking, they rethink stereotypes and rebuild their love in this rom-com.

name: De Big Fuck-Up
summary: Belgium, early 1980s. Jan Laureys wants to see the world and enjoy life, but reluctantly becomes a national police officer. His father, himself an officer in the gendarmerie, wants it that way. When Jan hears about the CDI, a new unit that will tackle drug criminals using American methods, he immediately puts himself forward as a candidate. They don't wear uniforms at the CDI, so he can continue to parade around the courtyard of the barracks in his fashionable outfits.

previousepisode.name: That pretty much sums it up

name: Oceans Africa
summary: Africa's coastlines host diverse marine life, from Atlantic upwellings to Indian Ocean reefs. Yet, human pressures disrupt ecosystems—seals hunt birds due to fish shortages, turtles ingest plastic, and sharks fall victim to protective nets. Aboard the Angra Pequena, scientists and volunteers work to safeguard these waters. Capture this urgent mission in a stunning visual journey.

name: Ling Du Ai Mei
summary: Wen Ni and Jian Yu Chen have been incompatible since high school and all the way to work. Everyone thinks that there is no chance for them to be together, but the ridiculous thing is that they have been secretly married for three years. They quarreled fiercely at the company during the day but made love again at night when they got home. They both knew each other tacitly and thought that they were physically compatible until they met Wen Ni's first love, Shen Huai Xu, at work. Jian Yu Chen's jealousy grew wildly. In order to prevent Wen Ni and Shen Huai Xu from rekindling their old love, Jian Yu Chen openly confessed his love to Wen Ni at his alma mater's anniversary celebration and made public their married relationship. Wen Ni then realized that Jian Yu Chen had been planning this for a long time and had been secretly in love with her for many years.

name: Життя на трьох
summary: A story about three completely different men who are forced to live under one roof in a rented apartment. Their secrets, dreams, and everyday troubles become the source of countless comic situations, revealing their contrasting lifestyles and interactions with the world around them. Despite all the household and personal challenges, the heroes learn to value friendship, overcome stress, and always find a reason to laugh.

name: Love Cabin
summary: Sexy singles venture into the woods to compete for love, sex and a 100k grand prize. Hosted by Ray J and Narrated by Tia Kemp.

name: Зрадники
summary: The show "Traitors" is an adaptation of the world hit The Traitors. The Ukrainian reality show features 22 participants competing for half a million hryvnias. Among them are "loyal" and "traitors". The task of the "loyal" is to expose the traitors, and the traitors - to reach the final. The action takes place in the Schönborn castle.

name: Qia Si Liu Huo Ru Han Yuan
Dear Secretary
summary: A domineering beauty boss meets her polished overseas-returnee secretary in the high-stakes corporate arena. Forced to collaborate, their initial friction sparks an unexpected romance, leading them from workplace rivals to lifetime partners.

name: Ângela Diniz: Assassinada e Condenada
summary: Based on true events, this drama series follows socialite Ângela Diniz, whose murder trial becomes a landmark in the country's history.

name: Papa and Daddy's Home Cooking
summary: Sengoku Akira, a chiropractor, doesn't know the first thing about raising a child. But when his ex-girlfriend suddenly entrusts him with their daughter, Airi, he's thrust into the deep end. So he moves in with his friend Harumi Masahiro – a divorced manga editor with a young son of his own. In exchange for rent, Akira cooks all their meals. After all, how hard can it be?

name: The Summit
summary: 12 stars, no experience in the wilderness and a million euros. The perfect combination for an adventure of a different kind. But because that's not enough, the mountain keeper also has a whole host of challenges at the start that will put the celebrities to the test, both physically and mentally. Who will manage to climb the summit and go home with up to one million euros at the end?

name: The Summit
summary: Twelve unknown Dutch people take on the ultimate challenge in Scandinavia to reach a remote mountain top within twelve days. With backpacks filled with a part of a quarter of a million euros, they have to reach the finish line. Those who give up on the way leave the mountain with his part of the money. Along the way, the mysterious Mountain keeper puts the participants to the test.

name: Embrace You Through the Ashes
summary: Jiang Wu has always lived in fear of debt collectors due to her father's disappearance, until she meets Jiang Yan, a silent man always covered in wounds, who takes her in and protects her. What she does not know is that he is actually an undercover police officer named Lu Xiao, who has infiltrated a border town gang incognito. The two lonely souls grow closer, yet she can never see through the mist in his eyes. At a critical juncture of his mission, he leaves without a word, leaving only some money and a letter telling her to forget him. Four years later, she becomes a reporter for North City TV, while he, retired due to injuries, runs a homestay called "Yearning for Wu." Fate brings them together again—she arrives with an interview list, and he calmly says he is Lu Xiao. Be it Jiang Yan or Lu Xiao, he remains an indelible part of her life. After years of hating him and searching for him, she now realizes that him keeping secrets and pushing her away are just to protect her.

name: Полёт со вкусом
summary: "Flight with Taste" is a gastronomic travel show, in each episode of which an eminent chef and a popular blogger travel to different cities of the world to discover the main tastes of the region for the audience. Their adventure begins already on board the plane. The chef creates a special menu inspired by the destination, and at the end of the issue, the blogger and chef will prepare a gala dinner based on the trip.

name: Bosch: Start of Watch
summary: The series will explore a city on the edge, teeming with racial tension, gang violence, and a fractured LAPD. Amid routine calls and growing unrest, Bosch finds himself drawn into a high-profile heist and a web of criminal corruption that will test his loyalty to the badge and shape his future as the detective who lives by the code, ‘Everybody counts or nobody counts.'

name: A Prescription for Revenge
summary: The modern-day divine doctor Lin Wanrou responds to the plea of the vengeful spirit of another Lin Wanrou, who died tragically in a different world. Activating the Book of Fate, she travels to that world on the very day of the other Lin Wanrou's wedding, determined to "defy destiny and rewrite her fate"! In the marquis's household, wolves lurk on all sides, each harboring their own schemes. Faced with deliberate humiliation and repeated traps from Xiao Yuan, Su Meier, her stepmother, and even the rest of the household, Lin Wanrou uses her intelligence and wit to resolve every crisis with ease. With her exceptional medical skills, she cures Xiao Yu's leg ailment and purges deadly poison. She also opens free clinics, rescues the declining Baicaotang medical hall, and revitalizes the marquis family's enterprises!

name: Forget That Night, Your Majesty
summary: Lunia, the daughter of the Count of Persephone, is chosen by a priest to be engaged to Hades, the head of the Duke of Khronoa family. The Duke of Khronoa, feared as the "King of the Underworld," is cursed with a short lifespan if he does not marry a bride chosen by the emperor. However, Hades tells Lunia that he has no intention of loving her. In order to keep Hades alive, Lunia deceived him and spent the night with him, then disappeared without realizing that she was pregnant with his child.

name: Lam Shamsia
summary: When Nelly suspects Wessam, her husband Tariq's friend, of harassing her stepson, she takes a stand—triggering a chain of events that lands the perpetrator in a coma and puts Tariq behind bars.

name: Ignite: Ho no Muhomono
summary: Uzaki Ryo is a rookie lawyer who is reckless but full of a sense of justice. After losing his father in an accident five years ago, Uzaki quit his job as a salaryman and decided to pursue a career in law. Although he finally passed the bar exam with great effort, he was rejected from every law firm interview and spent his days working part-time jobs. Just when he thought his luck had changed, he unexpectedly secured a job at "Peace Law Firm." He believed this was his chance to become a proper lawyer, but "Peace Law Firm" was not a place where lawyers waited for clients to come to them. Instead, it was an office full of lawless lawyers who infiltrated places where disputes were smoldering, stirring up lawsuits among the people.

name: 9 Gameat El Dowal
summary: A highly intelligent marine mechanical engineer named (Asfour) was able to form a large company, an import, export and maritime transport company with branches in various countries of the world, and with it social and human relations in his life. His life is characterized by the multiplicity of his feminine and emotional relationships, he discovers that he has children of multinationals from his multiple marriages.

name: Nekdeb Law Qolna Mabenhebesh
summary: The series follows Maryam, who is attached to her family and always helps them. As she always puts the happiness of those around her ahead of hers, something happens that changes her life completely and makes her rethink her way of living.

name: Citizen X
summary: The mini series features the Egyptian revolution on the 25th January 2011, portraying 3 young friends going through financial and social difficulties so they decide to revolt against the system, also demonstrating the face book revolution and how demonstrating in Tahrir square was organized. It even portrays the marriage that occurred in Tahrir Square during the revolution all the way up till the stepping down of the president.

name: Love is for the Dogs
summary: Hanamura Aiko is a skilled lawyer who specializes in divorce cases. She is a warm-hearted person who sympathizes with clients who are suffering from marital problems, but she grew up seeing her parents' discord, and has lost faith in romance and love. She dotes on her recently adopted dog, Sakura, and is enjoying her single life.

name: Idol I
summary: A romantic comedy drama and suspenseful mystery about a top star lawyer who has been a die-hard fan for 15 years, and an idol who hates his obsessive fans.

name: Dynamite Kiss
summary: A romance between a single woman who pretends to be a married mom in order to get a job, and the team leader who falls in love with her.

name: The Idea of Australia
summary: This bold and provocative four-part series asks the question – What is the idea of Australia and how might we learn from the past to make it stronger in the 21st century?

name: Alex vs ARod
summary:
From the pinnacle of athletic success to the depths of scandal, Alex Rodriguez saw his prolific baseball career marred by a high-profile suspension for performance-enhancing drug use. Told through a series of intimate interviews with Rodriguez, Alex vs ARod explores the dualities of one of the most polarizing figures in sports. 

With the benefit of hindsight and years of intense self-examination, Rodriguez confronts the personal struggles and controversies that shaped his journey from "Alex," a baseball prodigy abandoned by his father, to "A-Rod," the decorated MLB superstar driven by a relentless pursuit of greatness, no matter the cost. 

Featuring insights from family, friends, teammates, and broadcasters, the series examines the events that fueled Rodriguez's rise and fall, as well as his extraordinary talent, his place in baseball history, and the personal growth that defines his life as "Alex" today.

name: Marines
summary: Marines is a coming-of-age docuseries following the members of the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit (MEU), the US military's "force in readiness" in the Pacific. With unparalleled access to the US Marine Corps, the series offers an inside look into the rigorous trainings and emotional moments of young Marines as they forge bonds while grappling with the complexities of life at sea.

name: Брат и сестра
summary: 1994. Twelve-year-old Vasya and seven-year-old Nadya are sent to live with their uncle's family after their parents are killed by creditors for unpaid debts. Their father tried to start his own business and paid for it with his life. Their uncle, the deceased's brother, is a former party worker who hid from reality in alcohol. Vasya and Nadya decide to escape from a family where scandals and fights are the norm and start a new life in Moscow. Ten years later, they still have not forgotten their difficult childhood.

name: Andy en de Baksteen Belgen
summary: Construction Stress from A to Z: Andy and his family build their house, from plan to finish.

name: Huang Jin Pi De Gu Shi
Yi Lu Can Lan
summary:
Liu Jingl struggles after her 18-year-old daughter, Zhou Yi, disappears. An unexpected discovery pulls Liu Jingli into the past, joined by her friend Xu Xiaofeng to uncover the truth behind the mysterious circumstances surrounding Zhou Yi's fate. The search for answers also brings in journalist Liu Xiulian, the adoptive mother of Zhou Yi's classmate, Li Sibo. Li Sibo appears gentle and kind, seemingly helpful in uncovering the truth, but his own secrets gradually surface, linking him to Zhou Yi's past and revealing the complexities of his relationship with his mother.

Told across two timelines, blending past and present, the story follows the three women as they peel back layers of complex family dynamics, unsettling truths about certain aspects of Zhou Yi's past, and the secrets surrounding Li Sibo. As the investigation deepens, bringing shocking revelations that deeply affect the families, the search for answers leads to the truth behind Zhou Yi's fate.

name: Toshishita Cherry Boy-kun ni Honrou Saretemasu
summary: Imai Karen is a 29 year old cosmetics company employee, who has been unable to find true love due to a past trauma. While playing around with many men in her life, Karen meets Teito, a college student with zero experience in love at a drinking party. After noticing Teito, who is not intimidated by her "flirtatious techniques", Karen decides to try everything to get him to fall for her.

name: Браво! Бис!
summary: new grandiose vocal project, which will meet the triumphant, finalists and just bright talented heroes of the most popular music shows of the country. They will return to the stage to restart their careers, remind everyone what they are capable of, and compete for the love of the audience and the title of the winner.

name: Min Guo Qi Tan Zhi Qi Yuan Zhen Tan
Programa Cautelar
summary: A combination of humor and analysis, which tries to explain reality in a simple, fun and factual way.

name: Duolingo: The Final Test
summary: Duo the owl and his friends must navigate challenges to keep their streak and each other alive after being recruited as guardians to help language learners stay motivated.

name: Passing the Reins
summary: After a tax accountant's dream of joining his father's firm falls apart, he meets a wealthy horse owner and gets drawn into the world of horse racing.

name: Don't Call Me Ma'am
summary: Can women in their 40s still treat themselves to a little luxury called life? Once a legendary TV home shopping host, Na Jeong is now a stay-at-home mom exhausted by the daily battles of raising two kids. When a small lie unexpectedly lands her back at her old company as an intern host, her world turns upside down. Joo Young, the perfectionist director of an art center, has always kept everything under control until her career and marriage start to crack. And Il Ri, a hopeless romantic and magazine editor, struggles to choose between her ideals and reality. As three friends laugh, cry, and stumble their way through midlife crisis, they rediscover who they are and what truly matters. Perfect or not, their second act might be their best one yet.

name: Inside Bentley: A Great British Motorcar
summary: For the first time in its history, this quintessentially British institution opens its doors to see a new supercar go from paper to production; the much anticipated, Bentayga. This is car building the hard way: by hand.

name: Dr. Coto's Clinic
summary: After making a serious mistake in his work in Tokyo, talented surgeon Goto Kensuke is invited to take charge of the only clinic on the small island of Yonaguni, Okinawa. It is difficult to get competent doctors to serve on this remote island, and the islanders are now used to traveling for hours via boat for proper medical care. Despite seeming weak and unreliable (he gets very seasick, and does not have a driving license), he wins over the skeptical islanders with his skill and dedication. Some children of the island make a flag for his clinic, but get his name wrong. Thereafter he is known by all as Koto.

previousepisode.name: A Doctor's Fate from Which He Cannot Escape

name: Gui Mi Shuang Chuan Huang Nian，Gen Zhe Jie Mei Zhuan Da Qian
Spring Breeze That Cust Through the Thorns
Twin Blossoms in the Palace
summary: During the Daqing era, the Jiang family of the Imperial Medical Bureau suffered a massacre. Consort Yi, seeking the heart's blood of someone born in a "yin year and yin day" to refine an elixir, killed Madam Jiang as she tried to protect her daughters. With her dying breath, Madam Jiang instructed Jiang Wei and Jiang Yan to conceal their birth dates and protect each other for life. Ten years later, the sisters entered the palace disguised as medical attendants to avenge their family. Jiang Yan planned to win the emperor's attention with the Red Plum Dance, while Jiang Wei secured her position by solving the emperor's dilemma through the "Seven-Star Radiance Formation." The harem was rife with danger. Consort Yi forced Jiang Wei to destroy Jiang Yan's appearance, but Jiang Wei disfigured herself instead to protect her. The empress forged letters to frame the sisters for conspiring with Prince Yan in rebellion. To survive, the sisters staged a falling-out: Jiang Yan won favor and was granted the title of consort to restrain their enemies, while Jiang Wei worked in the shadows, collaborating with Prince Yan, who held military power, to uncover the truth: their father had been falsely accused of treason, and it had actually been the emperor who used the Prince of Zhennan to eliminate loyal officials. At Jiang Yan's coronation ceremony, Jiang Wei appeared with evidence that exposed the emperor's crimes. Prince Yan led his troops to seize control of the imperial guards, and the emperor abdicated. Five years later, Jiang Yan governed as regent to the young emperor, while Jiang Wei married Prince Yan. The sisters finally cleared their family's name, and each found their own happiness

name: Koifure ~ Koibito Miman ga Choudo ii
Ah! My Goddess: Fighting Wings
summary:
An Angel Eater has been freed in Heaven. Since Goddesses and Angels share body and soul, losing your angel results in going into shock for the Goddess. Lind goes to Earth to protect Belldandy and the others unknowing that it is a trap.

This is 20th Anniversary 2-part special that continues on the TV anime.

previousepisode.name: ああっ悦びを二人で共にっ

name: Цивилизация
summary: Ten ordinary people from across Russia will trace the evolution of humanity—from the Stone Age to the present day. In each episode, the participants will find themselves in specially recreated settings from a particular era, where they will have to adapt and prove themselves, overcoming challenging trials based on the real-life challenges of that time.

name: Σέρρες
summary:
Σέρρες is a Greek dramedy series created by Giorgos Kapoutzidis, blending heartfelt emotion with witty humor. The story follows Odysseas, a young gay man who returns to his conservative hometown of Serres after his mother's death, only to live with his estranged father. Together, they navigate grief, healing, and the awkward yet often hilarious process of reconnecting across generations and clashing values.

The series explores themes of LGBTQ+ identity, acceptance, family dynamics, and small-town life; all through a uniquely Greek lens. With sharp writing, tender performances, and Kapoutzidis's signature blend of charm and satire, Serres has quickly gained recognition for its fresh perspective and emotional depth.

Fifty Fifty (or 50-50 ) tells the story of the lives of three couples: Nikiforos and Elisabeth, Mimis and Xanthippi, Pavlos and Irini. The seemingly peaceful life of the group is gradually disturbed by Pavlos' extramarital affair with the young gymnast, Maria, the relationship of Natalia (daughter of Nikiforos and Elisabeth) with Achilles, and the relationship of Kimon (son of Mimis) with the cynical Vivian, who makes him her subordinate to inherit her father-in-law's fortune.

name: Black Cinderella: Sotsugyou-hen
summary: A 2-part special that takes place a year after the drama. With only a few weeks left in high school, the Seiran Academy is buzzing with talk of the graduation ceremony. Manaha and her classmates are faced with a choice about their future.

previousepisode.name: ブラックシンデレラ 卒業編 Part 2

name: Курицы vs Коровы
summary: Max and Pasha are confident that their startup, NeuroRefrigerator, will revolutionize the market. But a failed pitch and a meeting with the charismatic "investor" Felix take an unexpected turn: instead of a grant for their technology, the couple suddenly finds themselves the owners of a rural poultry farm.

name: Тест
summary: Ilya is a student on the verge of dropping out and a champion procrastinator. He lives under the wing of his caring girlfriend, but one day Lisa leaves, leaving him alone with an empty refrigerator and a cat—a survival test has begun. Trying to figure out "what's going on?" Ilya suddenly stumbles upon answers he certainly didn't expect.

name: It's Okay to Not Be Okay
summary: A selfless nurse aide crosses paths with a children's book author haunted by a dark past. As their lives intertwine, they confront the traumas that connect them and discover that healing often begins where pain is shared.

name: Esther Waters
summary: Based on the George Moore novel of the same title, Esther Waters is a Victorian lady who is abandoned by her lover when pregnant. Despite the social stigma of being a fallen woman she chooses to raise the child as a single mother.

name: Esther Waters
summary: Based on the George Moore novel of the same title, Esther Waters is a Victorian lady who is abandoned by her lover when pregnant. Despite the social stigma of being a fallen woman she chooses to raise the child as a single mother.

name: The Pingwings
summary: Pingwings was an animated black-and-white children's television series of 18 ten-minute episodes broadcast in the United Kingdom on ITV in 1961. Created by Oliver Postgate and Peter Firmin of Smallfilms, it starred a family of penguin-like creatures who lived at the back of a barn on Berrydown Farm. The Pingwing characters were knitted by Firmin's wife Joan and the animation was achieved using the stop-motion technique.

name: Grand Galaxy Hotel
summary: Only open in the middle of the night to provide top-class service and console the souls of the dead, the Grand Galaxy Hotel has a new owner, Eun-ha. Upon his arrival, he meets the human hotel manager Sang-soon, who does not fear ghosts.

name: Blazing Spring
summary: Using her sick mother against her, Jiang Man is coerced by her father into seducing Xie Yu Zhou. Xie Yu Zhou is a wealthy capital magnate from Hong Kong that actually knows Jiang Man's goal. While seducing him, Jiang Man gradually falls for him. After running away from the marriage, Xie Yu Zhou tracks her down. Their bond, which began in childhood, now makes it impossible for her to break free.

name: Reckless
summary: When feuding siblings June and Charlie cover up a hit and run in their hometown of Fremantle, their lives spiral wildly out of control. As the lies pile up, so do the consequences and soon, everyone in town has something to lose.

name: Hui Gu Niang De Shou Lie
Jia Gei Xin Ruan de Shen
Miki Černák: Miniséria
summary: 4 episode television miniseries inspired by real events of ex god father of Slovakian organized crime - Mikuláš Černák. Titular Miki from Telgart (village) could have had ordinary happy life, however after velvet revolution he developed taste for money. He and his friends engage in illegal deals losing moral restrictions in the process. "He who has power decides what the truth is, no matter how he gained it"

name: Sui Ran Bu Neng Tong Shi Yong You Yi Qie
The Golden Bachelor
summary: Hosted by Samantha Armytage, twenty incredible women are ready to win the heart of Bear, Australia's first Golden Bachelor. It's never too late to fall in love... again!

name: The Expert
summary: The professional and personal life of a Home Office pathologist.

name: Ben Onun Annesiyim
summary: Ayse spent years in prison after being accused of murdering her husband. Once released, her only wish is to be reunited with her daughter, Zeynep, who was taken from her as a child. But Zeynep has since been adopted by Kemal and knows nothing of her real mother. To reclaim her daughter, Ayse must earn Kemal's trust — and perhaps even his love. Her greatest obstacle, however, is her former mother-in-law, Ilter, who blames Ayse for her son's death and is determined to take revenge.

name: Mob War: Philadelphia vs. The Mafia
summary: A brutal mob war between John Stanfa and Joey Merlino plunges '90s Philadelphia into chaos and bloodshed in this captivating true-crime series.

name: Allen Iv3rson
summary: Allen Iv3rson delivers an unprecedented look at the NBA legend's story. This unflinching docu-series uses never-before-seen footage and exclusive interviews to reveal his remarkable rise from a poverty-stricken upbringing to cultural icon. It chronicles his sacrifice, resilience, and unwavering loyalty to family and community, showing how he redefined the game and empowered future generations.

name: Lakeside Retreats
summary: Designed to capture the essence of a weekend getaway, these gorgeous lakeside homes will have you planning your next escape.

name: История России от Петра до Павла
Rutger en de uitkeringstrekkers op vakantie
Tong Gu Jin Hou ， Wo Yang Cheng Le Wei Lai Jian Xiang
San Qian Xiang Si Wu Jin Chu
Queen of Darkness
summary: Ye Ying, a wealthy heiress, lost her memory in a car accident after a major upheaval in her life. She was mistaken for An Ning, a gentle housewife, and forced into a completely unfamiliar family.Relying on her hidden instincts to deal with the crises around her, she found herself irresistibly drawn to Huo Xiao, an inspector with complexities of his own. In the process of searching for her lost memories, a web of conspiracy and their complicated bond—as both foes and friends—became constantly intertwined. Eventually, this forced her to make a choice between false peace and the dangerous truth.

name: El cuco de cristal
summary: Clara Merlo, a first-year resident doctor, suffers a fatal heart attack that forces her to undergo a heart transplant. While recovering, the she feels the need to meet her donor, which leads her to a small inland town to learn about the life of the young man who gave her his heart. Clara thus delves into a place full of secrets, a mystery that extends over twenty years, and a closed-off town where, on the very day of her arrival, a baby disappears in a public park.

name: Музыка+
summary: Famous singers, artists, and musicians will be joining the program's studio. Expect a candid conversation at the highest level. Our guests will talk about their time and themselves, about what concerns each of us. They'll sing their hits and brand new songs, simply rocking it. There's plenty of good music and a boost of positive vibes. On Friday evenings, the stars shine brighter.

previousepisode.name: «Русские маяки»: поэт, актер, режиссер Влад Маленко, Николай Шкаруба и лидер группы «Лампасы» Игорь Тарасов

name: Cidro Asmoro
summary: DARU chose to leave his house, selling pecel rice, unable to stand hearing his parents ask him to go to Kalimantan, work, rather than expecting music that wasn't clear.
